title: Tumor Mutation Burden Prediction Model in Egyptian Breast Cancer patients based on Next Generation Sequencing.
authors: Nassar, Auhood; Lymona, Ahmed M; Lotfy, Mai M; Youssef, Amira Salah El-Din; Mohanad, Marwa; Manie, Tamer M; Youssef, Mina M G; Farahat, Iman G; Zekri, Abdel-Rhaman N
journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于NGS预测埃及乳腺癌患者的肿瘤突变负荷，仅涉及临床标志物与统计建模，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to identify the tumor mutation burden (TMB) value in Egyptian breast cancer (BC) patients. Moreover, to find the best TMB prediction model based on the expression of estrogen (ER), progesterone (PR), human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER-2), and proliferation index Ki-67. METHODS: The Ion AmpliSeq Comprehensive Cancer Panel was used to determine TMB value of 58 Egyptian BC tumor tissues. Different machine learning models were used to select the optimal classification model for prediction of TMB level according to patient's receptor status. RESULTS: The measured TMB value was between 0 and 8.12/Mb. Positive expression of ER and PR was significantly associated with TMB </= 1.25 [(OR =0.35, 95% CI: 0.04-2.98), (OR = 0.17, 95% CI= 0.02-0.44)] respectively. Ki-67 expression positive was significantly associated with TMB >1.25 than those who were Ki-67 expression negative (OR = 9.33, 95% CI= 2.07-42.18). However, no significant differences were observed between HER2 positive and HER2 negative groups. The optimized logistic regression model was TMB = -27.5 -1.82 ER - 0.73 PR + 0.826 HER2 + 2.08 Ki-67. CONCLUSION: Our findings revealed that TMB value can be predicted based on the expression level of ER, PR, HER-2, and Ki-67.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在确定埃及乳腺癌（BC）患者中的肿瘤突变负荷（TMB）值，并进一步基于雌激素（ER）、孕激素（PR）、人表皮生长因子受体2（HER-2）及增殖指数Ki-67的表达，寻找最佳的TMB预测模型。方法：使用Ion AmpliSeq Comprehensive Cancer Panel测定58例埃及BC肿瘤组织的TMB值。采用不同的机器学习模型，根据患者受体状态选择预测TMB水平的最优分类模型。结果：测得的TMB值介于0至8.12/Mb之间。ER和PR的阳性表达与TMB ≤ 1.25显著相关，其比值比（OR）分别为0.35（95%置信区间：0.04-2.98）和0.17（95%置信区间：0.02-0.44）。Ki-67阳性表达与TMB >1.25显著相关，其OR为9.33（95%置信区间：2.07-42.18），高于Ki-67阴性表达者。然而，HER2阳性组与HER2阴性组之间未观察到显著差异。优化后的逻辑回归模型为：TMB = -27.5 - 1.82 ER - 0.73 PR + 0.826 HER2 + 2.08 Ki-67。结论：我们的研究结果表明，TMB值可根据ER、PR、HER-2和Ki-67的表达水平进行预测。
